firstLines: Marisol Vega
Sacramento, CA | (916) 555-0146 | marisol.vega@example.com | linkedin.com/in/marisolvega
SUMMARY
Retail store manager moving into data analysis. For eight years I've run stores on numbers, from labor plans to
shrink, and for the last two I've done the analysis myself in SQL and Tableau. Looking for a junior analyst role
where I can work with sales and operations data.
SKILLS
Data: SQL, Excel (pivot tables), Tableau
Business: Forecasting, inventory, labor planning
Certifications: Google Data Analytics Certificate
RELEVANT PROJECTS
Shrink Analysis | SQL and Excel, my own store's data 2025
• Matched two years of inventory counts to sales; three product groups caused 60% of losses
• Changed how those items were shown and counted; shrink fell from 2.4% to 1.6% of sales
Regional Sales Dashboard | Tableau, public retail data 2025
• Built a dashboard comparing weekly sales by store and category, with notes on what changed and why
WORK HISTORY
Cholla & Clay Home Goods Sacramento, CA
Store Manager Mar 2020 – Present
• Run a store with $6.2 million in yearly sales and a team of 28
• Build the weekly labor plan from sales forecasts; labor cost on budget for 14 straight quarters
• Report weekly results to the district manager and explain the gaps
Turnip & Tansy Market Sacramento, CA
Assistant Store Manager Jun 2016 – Feb 2020
• Ordered and tracked inventory for grocery and frozen departments
• Trained 30 new hires on registers, ordering and safety procedures
EDUCATION AND TRAINING
Bosquelind Community College Sacramento, CA
Associate of Science in Business Administration May 2016
• Data analytics certificate: SQL, spreadsheet modeling, Tableau, statistics
